script:
# D3-SO-004: Solvolysis and thermal elimination share a leaving group, not a product
# Simulation candidate; no runtime observations are claimed.
new
add v1 water 40mL @ 25C
add v2 water 40mL @ 90C
seal v1 500mL
seal v2 500mL
add v1 tert_butyl_bromide 0.0002mol
add v2 tert_butyl_bromide 0.0002mol
react v1 haloalkane
react v2 haloalkane
measure v1 ph
measure v2 ph
particles v1
particles v2
measure v2 thermometer
inspect
